senses.en_definition: To be able to do something.
To get or receive something, or experience a particular treatment or outcome.
To find someone or something being sought.

collocations.en: keep looking until you find it

senses.en_definition: To succeed in doing something or achieve a desired result.

collocations.en: achieve what one has aspired to

messages.en: I got the job at that shop! I start this Monday.
Wow, congrats! It's right near your place, isn't it? Getting to work will be easy then.

senses.en_definition: To obtain or secure something through effort, often used in instructions or requests.
To go to or approach someone.

messages.en: Are you heading to the counter downstairs? Could you grab that claim form for me while you're there?
Two, please—one for me and one for Lina. Thanks!
I'm still in the kitchen, getting dinner ready.
I'm home now. I'll help chop the vegetables, then.

senses.en_definition: The red fluid that circulates through the bodies of humans and animals.
An innate talent or natural ability.

collocations.en: have a natural talent for the arts

messages.en: I saw the photo earlier—there was blood on your shirt. Did you cut your hand?
Yeah, I scratched it a bit while moving the table earlier. Didn't notice I'd got blood on my shirt.
